proposal: Filter design report with OEM confirmation, plus an Na+K air sampler downstream of the filters with 12 months of data reported during the Defects Notification Period.
question: ER-02.10 requires Na+K at the compressor inlet within the OEM limit at the storm maximum (165 ug/m3). This cannot be tested on demand. Please accept verification by analysis plus monitoring.
response: Accepted as proposed: verification by filter design report with OEM confirmation plus 12 months of Na+K air sampling downstream of the filters, reported during the Defects Notification Period.
